caption_L1: This bar plot is called Heads of state and government with the highest annual salaries (2010 or latest update ; in dollars). The x-axis plots Annual salary in dollars along linear scale from 0 to 2,000,000 while the y-axis plots head of state on categorical scale with Angela Merkel (Germany) on one end and Stephen Harper (Canada) at the other.
caption_L2L3: Lee Hsien Loong earns the most, at just over 2,000,000 dollars per annum. The difference in salary between the highest earner (Singapore) and second highest earner, Mwal Kibaki (Kenya) is just over 1,500,000 dollars. With the exception of Singapore’s head of state, all heads of state earn less than 500,000 dollars per year. David Cameron (UK) earns the least amount per year.
